PROCLAMATION OF EMERGENCY
PROCLAMATION OF EMERGENCY 1990
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part III 6th August, 1990]
No.43/I/90‑M, dated 6‑8‑1990.‑‑Whereas
the President is satisfied that a grave emergency exists in which the security
of Pakistan is threatened by external aggression and by internal disturbance
beyond the ‑ power of Provincial Governments to control.
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (I) of Article 232 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to issue hereby this
Proclamation of Emergency.
